title: Level 1 (Beginner) - A-15
notes:
South has more than enough tricks. 2 spade tricks, the ♥A, the ♦A, and 6 club tricks, add up to 10. However, South must be careful at trick 1. If the spade lead is won in the dummy the contract will fail as only 3 of the 6 club tricks will be available. After cashing the ♣A, ♣K, and ♣Q South will have no entry to enjoy North's clubs.

This problem can be avoided by winning the opening lead in the South hand with the ♠A. South's 3 top clubs can next be cashed. The North hand can be entered in spades so that the long clubs can be enjoyed.
